title: Repair migrated source catalogue verification after Navigator move

slices: Resolve and assert the current sibling Navigator source root, then verify 29 Navigator packages map one-to-one to Anomaly's 28 non-Arbiter packages.
Scan only intended checked-in text/resource suffixes in stable order while ignoring hidden filesystem metadata such as .DS_Store.
Reuse the offline adapter result-contract, forbidden-surface, ThinkPol-specific, lazy-loading, registry-safety, and explicit no-Arbiter checks.
Run only the targeted source catalogue test file and record pre-update RED plus post-update targeted evidence.

redRun.output: Pre-update: 2 failed, 9 passed because the test used the removed navigator/osint-navigator/data/skills path and attempted to decode .DS_Store. After the test contract update: 11 passed.

plan.refactorOpportunity: Consolidate duplicated catalogue text traversal into the metadata-safe _text_files helper while preserving existing forbidden-surface and ThinkPol scan behavior.

greenRun.output: 11 passed in 0.26s; no production or test files edited by implementer because plan-authored test contract was already green.
